title: quickkb Golden Case
description: Schema for quick-knowledge SkillOpt benchmark cases (bench/cases/<skill>/items.json).

input.description: User-natural-language input. MUST NOT contain SKILL.md jargon or template words.

user_choice.description: Polish menu selection: 1=accept polished, 2=keep original, 3=retry. null = not applicable.

path_glob.description: Glob pattern for the produced file path. Empty string means NO file should be produced.

frontmatter.description: Map of field-name → regex. Each value is matched (re.search) against the actual frontmatter field's string repr. Nested keys allowed via dot notation (e.g. 'source.url').

frontmatter_forbidden.description: Fields that MUST NOT appear in the produced frontmatter.

content_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the produced content body.

content_excludes.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in the produced content body.

should_trigger_polish.description: Whether the v1.2 polish menu (with [1][2][3] markers) should appear in the reply.

feedback_contains.description: Substrings that must appear in the skill's feedback/reply text.

flow_upstream_file.description: J-class only. Path to a fixture JSON describing the upstream skill's produced state.

flow_downstream_check.description: J-class only. Metadata describing which downstream skill + fields are checked.

references.description: Source-of-truth pointers (SKILL.md section numbers, ADR IDs).
